source: Picked from OpenTable's Portsmouth date-night list, The Infatuation and Wikipedia landmarks, Nov 2026

spots.name: Prescott Park
spots.blurb: Waterfront park and gardens on the Piscataqua, across from Strawbery Banke.
spots.blurbEs: Parque y jardines junto al río Piscataqua, frente a Strawbery Banke.

spots.name: Strawbery Banke Museum
spots.blurb: Ten-acre outdoor history museum; its Candlelight Stroll runs Dec 4–6, 11–13 and 18–20.
spots.blurbEs: Museo de historia al aire libre de diez acres; su Candlelight Stroll es del 4 al 6, del 11 al 13 y del 18 al 20 de diciembre.

spots.name: Odiorne Point State Park & Seacoast Science Center
spots.blurb: Rocky oceanfront park with trails and tide pools, home to the Seacoast Science Center.
spots.blurbEs: Parque costero rocoso con senderos y pozas de marea, sede del Seacoast Science Center.
